name: Ollama Status
description: Models, loaded models and their CPU/GPU memory split; pull and delete models; shows how Ollama is installed (service, nssm, Docker), updates it, starts and stops it, sets its startup method or restart policy, and installs it. Installed by default. The view and these flows are built into Bosun; this package carries its permissions, size and tracked statistics.
author: Bosun

permissions.label: See Ollama
permissions.description: See the Ollama Status widget and the model list of a server.

permissions.label: Pull Ollama models
permissions.description: Download models onto the host (and cancel a download).

permissions.label: Install, update and control Ollama
permissions.description: Install Ollama on the host (a Windows service with nssm, a Docker container or a systemd service), update it, start and stop it, change its startup method or restart policy.

permissions.label: Delete Ollama models
permissions.description: Remove downloaded models from the host.

widgets.description: Models, loaded models and their CPU/GPU memory split; pull and delete (admin)

view.text: Ollama Status is drawn by Bosun itself.
